calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-17-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of two Minors.
Petitioner: Xhu Ying Liang, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Wan Ling Zhao and Jing Hong Zhao, and with Cantonese Interpreter: Shuna Lei.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No appearance by the Co-Petitioner/Minor's Father: Peng Bo Zhao, but singed the Petition consenting to the name change of the two Minors.
No objections to the proposed change of name of the Minor were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minors to: Jamie Wanling Zhao and Jason Jinghong Zhao.
Decree signed in open court.
